name: OCBC 365 Credit Card
annual_fee_note: S$ | First 2 Years Waived. Min. spend of S$10,000 per year for waiver of annual fee for subsequent years.

percent:local.note: Up to | With minimum spending of S$800 or S$1,600 per calendar month. Cashback capped at S$80 or S$160, depending on minimum spend.

percent:health.note: Only for purchases made at pharmacies like Guardian or Watson. With minimum spending of $800 per calendar month.

percent:online_bill_payment_spending.note: Only for streaming services like Netflix, Disney+, Spotify and Apple Music. With minimum spending of $800 per calendar month.

percent:transport.note: Bus and train rides using SimplyGo. Local and overseas private hire rides (e.g. Grab (excluding GrabPay), Gojek and TADA). Local and overseas taxi rides (e.g. ComfortDelGro). With minimum spending of $800 per calendar month.

percent:dining.note: Online food delivery, local and overseas dining with min. S$800 spend per calendar month.

percent:petrol.note: With minimum spending of $800 per calendar month. 3% cashback on EV charging spend at Charging stations (e.g. SP Digital, Greenlots, Virta Charging Stations and City Energy).

percent:supermarket.note: With minimum spending of $800 per calendar month.

rewards_bonus_cap.note: Up to S$ | Meet S$1,600 min. monthly spend to unlock S$160 / month cashback cap. Otherwise, meet S$800 min. monthly spend to get S$80 / month cashback cap.

cashback_bonus_cap.note: Up to S$ | Meet S$1,600 min. monthly spend to unlock S$160 / month cashback cap. Otherwise, meet S$800 min. monthly spend to get S$80 / month cashback cap.

highlights: 6% cashback on petrol and up to 6% on local spending, with 5% cashback on dining. You'll also earn 3% cashback on supermarkets, health expenses, transport, and online bill payments for streaming services like Netflix and Disney+, and other FCY spending earns 0.25% cashback. Note: all cashback is available with a minimum monthly spend of $800 on eligible purchases and S$160 monthly cashback cap with mininum spend of $1,600.
pros: 6% cashback on fuel spend at all other petrol stations.
pros: 5% cash rebate on dining spends all day, everyday (includes local/overseas dining and online food delivery).
pros: 3% cashback on drugstore purchases, streaming service subscriptions and EV charging expenses.
pros: 3% cashback on groceries at supermarkets (both local and overseas) and online groceries.
pros: 3% cashback on private hire (Grab/Gojek) and taxi rides (both local and overseas).
pros: 3% cashback on recurring telco and electricity bills.
pros: S$160 monthly cashback cap (up from S$80).
pros: Up to 22.92% fuel savings at Caltex (incl. 18% instant discount for all fuel) and 6% cashback on fuel spend at all other petrol stations.
pros: 2-year annual fee waiver.
pros: Earn up to 4.65% p.a. interest on first S$100,000 of OCBC 365 Account balance.
pros: Great for homemakers, working adults, cashback lovers, enjoy flexibility over min. spend (S$800 or S$1,600), drive frequently

cons: S$160 monthly cashback cap with mininum spend of $1,600.
cons: Operates on a whitelist basis. Only selected MCCs shown in the T&Cs qualify for bonus cashback.

extra.tag: Best for cashback on dining, groceries, and recurring bills
extra.description: The OCBC 365 Card is a generous everyday cashback card earning 2X more cashback (of up to S$160): 6% cashback on petrol, 5% cashback on dining and food delivery, and 3% cashback on groceries, public transport, ride-hailing, pharmacy, streaming, and EV charging.
